description: Dependency automation for resume. Added 2026-10-26, modelled on the budget repo.
The gate is CI (.github/workflows/tests.yml): PHPUnit on sqlite, phpstan level 5
with an EMPTY baseline, pint --test, a real npm run build, composer audit and
npm audit. Auto-merge is kept deliberately narrow: patch-level dev dependencies
only. Everything that can reach a visitor needs a human.

schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes bypass the weekly schedule entirely. Never auto-merged - a human sees every one.

packageRules.description: Dev dependencies, patch only -> auto-merge. Lowest blast radius.
Dev dependencies, minor -> grouped PR, human merges.
Runtime dependencies -> grouped PR, human merges. These reach visitors.
Every major gets its own PR and a human. Never grouped, never auto-merged.
Laravel and PHP itself are pinned by composer.json constraints and are a deliberate, planned upgrade - not a routine bump.
